title: Software Engineer Java/Go
description:
Requisitos técnicos:

  • AWS : experiência sólida com serviços como Lambda, Step Functions, DynamoDB, SNS/SQS , além de capacidade de aprender rapidamente serviços novos (ex.: Kinesis).

title: Indirect Tax Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu tax team ensures compliance with local and international tax laws while optimizing the company’s tax position. We handle tax planning, reporting, and risk management, working closely with other departments to drive efficiencies. Our dynamic team offers growth opportunities in a fast-paced, evolving environment, valuing accuracy and innovative problem-solving.


We are seeking a proactive and experienced Tax BP to support our tax compliance and audit activities in Brazil. This role will be critical in ensuring full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, managing tax audits, and acting as a key liaison between internal teams and external tax authorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation, excellent communication skills in both Portuguese and English, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.


Job description

  • The Tax Senior/Manager will be responsible for the management of indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning, ensuring compliance with current legislation and the optimization of the tax burden;
  • Ensure timely and accurate preparation and filing of all tax returns (direct and indirect taxes), including PIS/COFINS, ICMS, ISS, etc.
  • Monitor tax compliance processes and work closely with internal accounting and finance teams to ensure tax obligations are met.
  • Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
  • Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.


Desired profile

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
  • Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;
  • Knowledge in Tax reform;
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills with different stakeholders;


Language:

  • Fluent in Portuguese (native proficiency).
  • Fluent in English (written & spoken) – must liaise with global teams.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Analista de FP&A
description:
A Sun Pharma é a quarta maior empresa farmacêutica especializada em genéricos do mundo, com receitas globais de US$ 5,4 bilhões. Apoiados por 43 instalações de produção, fornecemos medicamentos de alta qualidade e acessíveis, com a confiança de profissionais de saúde e pacientes, para mais de 100 países em todo o mundo.


Buscamos um(a) profissional com habilidade para atuar de forma estratégica e colaborativa junto a stakeholders internos e externos. Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas demandas e cumprimento dos prazos . Valorizamos perfil proativo, organizado e com boa comunicação interpessoal, que possua habilidade de cultivar bons relacionamentos e atuar em um ambiente dinâmico.


Reaching People And Touching Lives Globally


Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como Business Partner financeiro junto aos demais departamentos, fornecendo análises e informações para tomada de decisão;
  • Consolidar diferentes relatórios gerenciais em Excel e compreender os desvios dos resultados mensais versus Budget e Forecast , além de sugerir planos de ação. Irá acessar a plataformas de BI e extrair dados do Protheus/Microsiga;
  • Participar da elaboração e consolidação dos exercícios de Budget e Forecast, incluindo a elaboração de premissas junto aos gestores de cada unidade de negócio, além de coordenar atividades e prazos de entrega;
  • Elaborar apresentações executivas com os principais indicadores financeiros para o Board da empresa;
  • Colaborar na implementação de novos processos e aprimoramento das melhores práticas (S&OP’s) da área financeira.


Requisitos:

  • Graduação em Administração ou Ciências Contábeis;
  • Conhecimento avançado de Excel;
  • Conhecimento na utilização de outras ferramentas de análise de dados - como BI e/ou IA - será um diferencial;
  • Domínio dos conceitos envolvidos nas demonstrações financeiras (DRE, DFC e BP);
  • Inglês intermediário é mandatório.

title: UX Wordpress Elementor / Digital Display Ad & Video Ad / Mobile App Designers
description:
Please only apply if you are really a 'full stack' designer with a variety of seasoned skills incluidng design Elementor Wordpress AND digital display ads that are graphic intensive AND ad video shorts PLUS Bonus for Mobile App design.


Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong creative skills and a portfolio of work which demonstrates passion for UX design with skills ranging from Wordpress Elementor sites & landing pages to ad sets to ad video shorts to mobile app design? Do you have experience working with numerous different design platforms especially in digital form, especially Adobe Creative Suite? Have you made eye-catching animated digital ads? Have you made social media video ads with AI characters like HeyGen and searched for stock video and audio footage based on the sales scripts?


Portfolio of web and digital ad design REQUIRED to be considered for the position.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies and other large scale projects. We started in 2019.


Responsibilities

  • Handle multiple graphic projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by Creative Director.
  • Create UX landing pages on Wordpress with Elementor with provided copy and details set by Creative Director.
  • Create eye-catching display ads with animation on creatopy.com that stimulate visitors from Facebook, Google, etc
  • Create multiple variations of compelling, memorable logos, custom web graphics, web page designs, and digital media ads that reflect critical thinking and design excellence.
  • Stylize the copy provided from our writers into a custom Wordpress page so that it's aesthetically pleasing, professional, unique.
  • Review success of ads and suggest updates and new ads styles.
  • Create Web design layouts, company presentations, brochure, investor decks, infographics, and PowerPoint presentations.
  • Strong knowledge of UX design for websites, native and social apps
  • Open to using additional apps such as midjourney.com (unique ai images), creatopy.com (for automated ad sizing), (additional landing page platform, similar to Elementor), capcut, etc.
  • Able to make TikTok and Youtube ad video shorts based on sales scripts with stock video and audio
  • Able to make mobile app designs on Figma


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, typography skills and design skills
  • HTML/CSS design
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have excellent grammar skills
  • Must have the ability to multitask, work in a busy environment just as good as in solitude. This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level

Bonuses: Performance and team share bonuses


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • Portfolio of your digital media work ranging from ads to web pages.


Requirements Before Employment

  • Short paid test project showcasing landing page, video and digital ads to assess work quality with our spec
  • Signed Independent Contractor Agreement and w8-Ben (USA tax form for International)


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.

title: API Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

title: NGS Scientific & Technical Operations Manager – LATAM
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY



MGI is at the forefront of genomics innovation, delivering cutting-edge sequencing technologies and advancing life sciences research worldwide. We are dedicated to enabling affordable, effective healthcare solutions and expanding our impact across the Americas. If you’re passionate about genomics, NGS, and making a real difference in healthcare and research, join us on this exciting journey toward accessible innovation for all.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are seeking an experienced NGS Scientific & Technical Operations Manager – LATAM to lead our Scientists, Field Service Engineers, Bioinformatics, Quality, and Customer Experience teams across Latin America. This leadership role requires a solid scientific foundation in molecular biology, genetics, bioinformatics, or related life sciences, combined with strong operational and people management skills. You will ensure exceptional customer support, technical excellence, and continuous improvement across all post-sales service functions in the region.



RESPONSIBILITIES



  • Report directly to the Head of LATAM and collaborate closely with Global Technical Support, Training, Sales, and Service Operations leaders.
  • Lead and mentor a multidisciplinary team including Field Application Scientists, Field Service Engineers, Field Bioinformaticians, and Customer Support professionals.
  • Oversee customer satisfaction and operational efficiency, ensuring that service requests, installations, and technical issues are managed effectively and within expected timelines.
  • Define individual training and development needs across the technical team and recommend staffing plans and hiring strategies.
  • Establish measurable goals and performance indicators (e.g., response time, first-time resolution, quality metrics).
  • Manage regional service operations including resource allocation, travel budgets, spare part inventory, and field reporting.
  • Ensure accurate communication and coordination between LATAM and global operations, cascading critical updates and initiatives.
  • Serve as the technical and operational lead for the Customer Experience Center (CEC) and Demo Lab, driving technical demonstrations and customer engagement.
  • Maintain alignment with global quality standards, ensuring compliance, traceability, and continuous improvement of support processes.
  • Able to support and coordinate teams across the LATAM time zones.


QUALIFICATIONS



  • Master’s degree (or higher) in Genetics, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Strong academic background or work experience in NGS (Next Generation Sequencing) is highly preferred.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in technical support, field service, or applications management, ideally within the genomics or life sciences industry.
  • Proven leadership and people management skills, with experience guiding technical and scientific teams.
  • Excellent communication and organizational abilities; capable of navigating global structures and driving results across functions.
  • Willingness to travel regionally and internationally, including occasional training or collaboration trips to China.


PAY RANGE AND COMPENSATION PACKAGE



MGI offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package to employees and their dependents (including domestic partners), which includes:



  • Medical and dental coverage
  • Travel insurance
  • Meal vouchers
  • Gym allowance


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT



MGI is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Lead Engineer – Agentic AI
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Lead Engineer – Agentic AI , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract.


In this role you will:

You’ll lead the architecture, development, and deployment of next-generation agentic AI systems that transform enterprise operations. These intelligent agents will autonomously orchestrate workflows, analyze real-time data, and embed decision-making across domains like finance, sales, and operations. You’ll guide cross-functional teams, mentor engineers, and ensure technical excellence across all stages of delivery. Microsoft AI Foundry will be a key platform for agent development, and Copilot Studio may be used optionally for few use cases.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and lead development of scalable, production-grade agentic AI systems.
  • Design serverless, event-driven workflows using Azure Functions , Logic Apps , and Power Automate .
  • Build and optimize ML models for predictive analytics, anomaly detection, and recommendations using Azure ML , Databricks , and Python .
  • Integrate agents with enterprise platforms such as SAP HANA , Salesforce , Snowflake , Kafka , and UiPath .
  • Ensure observability and reliability through Azure Monitor , logging, and alerting frameworks.
  • Define and enforce architecture patterns, reusable components, and governance standards.
  • Lead code reviews, technical design sessions, and agile ceremonies.
  • Leverage Microsoft AI Foundry to build and deploy agents that meet enterprise-grade standards.


Leadership Responsibilities

  • Mentor and coach junior engineers, fostering a culture of innovation and technical excellence.
  • Drive cross-team collaboration and alignment on agentic AI strategy and execution.
  • Own delivery timelines, quality benchmarks, and stakeholder communication.
  • Champion best practices in DevOps, CI/CD, and model lifecycle management.
  • Stay ahead of trends in AI, machine vision, and IoT to guide strategic decisions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with:

  • Data Scientists & ML Engineers – for model development and integration
  • Product Managers & UX Designers – aligning agent capabilities with user needs
  • Enterprise Architects & DevOps Engineers – ensuring scalability and deployment efficiency
  • Security & Compliance Teams – meeting regulatory and governance requirements
  • Business Stakeholders & SMEs – defining use cases and validating outcomes
  • Change Management & Enablement Teams – supporting adoption and training efforts

Technology & Tools

  • Languages & Platforms : Python, Power Apps, Power Automate, Databricks, Snowflake
  • Enterprise Systems : SAP HANA, Kafka, UiPath
  • AI Platforms : Microsoft AI Foundry (highly preferred ), Copilot Studio (optional )
  • Cloud & ML Tools : Azure Machine Learning, Azure DevOps, GitHub
  • Data & Observability : Vector Databases, Azure Monitor
  • Vision & IoT : Azure IoT Hub, OpenCV, TensorFlow, PyTorch (for edge and vision-based agents)

What You Bring

  • Proven experience leading AI engineering teams and delivering enterprise-grade solutions
  • Strong technical depth in AI/ML, cloud platforms, and agentic system design
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, drive clarity, and influence across functions
  • Passion for building transformative AI systems that solve meaningful problems

description:

Quer fazer parte desse time?


Então, olhe só a oportunidade que temos para você:


O que você fará:


  • Trabalhar com planilha dinâmica e funções do Excel de modo avançado e elaboração de apresentações no Powerpoint;
  • Atuar com softwares de pesquisa de mídia como Instar, Monitor, AdInsights, TGI entre outros;
  • Elaboração de informes de performance de audiência e estudos de público / personas;
  • Gerar insights através de números / pesquisa;

  • Manipulação de grupos no Monitor Evolution para envio de base aos clientes.


O que você precisa ter:✔


  • Conhecimento em Excel e Power Point (avançados);

title: Consultor SAP ABAP
description:
Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Consultor(a) ABAP para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo, desenvolvendo e sustentando soluções customizadas em SAP.

A pessoa será responsável por implementar melhorias, realizar correções e participar de projetos de evolução do sistema, garantindo a qualidade e performance das entregas.


Responsabilidades

Desenvolver, implementar e dar suporte a programas ABAP (Reports, Interfaces, Forms, Enhancements e Exits).

Atuar em melhorias e correções em módulos SAP (FI, CO, MM, SD, HCM, entre outros).

Realizar análise técnica de demandas funcionais, propondo soluções aderentes ao sistema.

Apoiar os times funcionais e de negócio na definição de escopo e testes das soluções desenvolvidas.

Garantir a qualidade do código e aderência às boas práticas de desenvolvimento SAP.

Elaborar documentação técnica e acompanhar homologações junto aos usuários-chave.


Requisitos obrigatórios

Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento ABAP .

Conhecimento em Smartforms, ALV, BAPIs, BADIs, User Exits, IDOCs e RFCs .

Vivência em projetos de implementação, rollouts ou sustentação SAP .

Capacidade de análise técnica e trabalho colaborativo com times funcionais.


Diferenciais

Experiência com S/4HANA e ABAP OO .

Conhecimento em ferramentas de integração (PI/PO, CPI).

Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

Inglês técnico.


Soft Skills

Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal.

Proatividade e foco em resultado.

Capacidade analítica e atenção aos detalhes.

Organização e senso de prioridade.

title: Consultor Senior ERP
description:
Na LatamReady, somos a referência na implementação de Oracle NetSuite para empresas em expansão em toda a América Latina. Não apenas implementamos software; transformamos negócios e os ajudamos a escalar. Para continuar esta missão, buscamos incorporar ao nosso time Consultores(as) ERP Sênior de alto calibre.


Sua Missão como Consultor(a) ERP Sênior:


Você será peça-chave na otimização dos processos de negócio de nossos clientes através da implementação e consultoria especializada em soluções ERP. Seu conhecimento em sistemas como SAP (Business One, S/4HANA), Microsoft Dynamics (AX, NAV, 365), Oracle (EBS, JD Edwards) ou, idealmente, Oracle NetSuite, será fundamental para desenhar e implementar soluções que gerem impacto real.


O Que Esperamos de Você?


  • Domínio Comprovado em ERPs (+5 anos Implementando ERPs): Precisamos da sua experiência tangível no ciclo completo de projetos ERP: desde a análise de necessidades, design da solução, configuração, até a implantação e o suporte pós-implementação. Não basta conhecer a teoria; buscamos resultados comprovados.
  • Visão de Negócio: Você entenderá os desafios e objetivos de negócio dos nossos clientes para traduzir suas necessidades em soluções ERP funcionais e eficientes que agreguem valor quantificável.
  • Capacidade de Execução: Liderará e executará projetos de implementação, assegurando a qualidade, o cumprimento de prazos e a satisfação do cliente.
  • Comunicação Direta e Eficaz: Você se comunicará com clareza e precisão tanto com as equipes técnicas quanto com os níveis diretivos dos nossos clientes.
  • Inglês Avançado Indispensável: A interação com equipes e documentação internacional é constante. Um nível de inglês avançado, tanto oral quanto escrito, é um fator determinante para o sucesso nesta posição.


O Que Você Terá ao se Juntar à LatamReady?


  • A oportunidade de trabalhar com empresas líderes e em crescimento em toda a região.
  • Projetos desafiadores que permitirão aplicar sua expertise e gerar um impacto real.
  • Ser parte de uma organização focada na excelência, com um profundo conhecimento de Oracle NetSuite e do mercado latino-americano.
  • Um ambiente onde sua contribuição direta para o sucesso de nossos clientes é o principal indicador de seu desempenho.
  • Compensação competitiva e desenvolvimento profissional na principal solução Cloud ERP do mundo.


Se você é um(a) Consultor(a) ERP com profundo conhecimento em sistemas ERP, clara orientação a resultados, domina o inglês em nível avançado e está pronto(a) para levar sua carreira ao próximo nível em um ambiente dinâmico e focado, esta é sua oportunidade!

Candidate-se aqui! Estamos buscando os melhores. Mostre-nos que é você.

title: Analista de Suporte - Protheus
description:
Descrição da vaga

O principal objetivo dessa posição é apoiar os clientes em projetos que vão desde a implementação e otimização dos módulos do sistema Protheus, garantindo que as soluções entregues não apenas atendam, mas superem as expectativas de negócio.

Nesta posição, você terá um papel fundamental na entrega de valor e na satisfação do cliente. Você será responsável por entender profundamente os processos de negócio, mapear os requisitos e configurar os módulos do Protheus de acordo com o escopo de cada projeto.

Um diferencial, conhecimento no Configurador de Tributos do módulo Fiscal do Protheus, para apoio aos clientes na Reforma Tributária.




Responsabilidades e atribuições

● Projetos de Implantação: Configuração e o setup dos módulos, desde o levantamento inicial até a homologação final, garantindo que a transição seja suave e eficiente para o cliente.

● Melhoria Contínua: Implementar módulos e rotinas já em uso, como a criação/escopo de rotin

aspersonalizadas ou a automação de processos, visando aumentar a produtividade e reduzir gargalos.

● Atuação Estratégica: Participar de reuniões com clientes e parceiros para entender as demandas, desenhar soluções técnicas e apresentar propostas, demonstrando seu conhecimento técnico e sua capacidade de influenciar positivamente o resultado.

● O grande desafio será traduzir a complexidade de negócios em configurações e funcionalidades no Protheus, atuando em diferentes segmentos de mercado e se adaptando rapidamente a novas realidades. Se você é apaixonado por tecnologia, tem uma ótima comunicação e adora resolver problemas, esta é a oportunidade perfeita para você crescer e deixar sua marca em projetos de grande impacto.

● Liderança Técnica e Mentoria: O Analista Sênior é um pilar de conhecimento para a equipe. Inclua a responsabilidade de orientar e capacitar analistas de níveis júnior e pleno. Ele(a) deve ser a referência técnica para questões complexas e um mentor(a) para o desenvolvimento da equipe.

● Gestão de Projetos e Escopo Complexo: Além de participar, o sênior apoia a gerência de projetos de grande escala e alta complexidade. Isso envolve participar do planejamento, da definição de escopo e a gestão de riscos, garantindo que os projetos sejam entregues no prazo e dentro do orçamento.

● Resolução de Problemas Críticos e Tomada de Decisão: A capacidade de resolver problemas é levada a um novo patamar. O sênior é o(a) responsável por solucionar os desafios mais difíceis e críticos que a equipe não consegue resolver. A vaga deve destacar a habilidade de tomar decisões sob pressão, com base em sua vasta experiência.


Requisitos e qualificações

● Formação superior em: Superior completo na área de TI ( Ciências da Computação, Análise de Sistemas, Engenharia da Computação) Gestão de Projetos, Administração de Sistemas e áreas relacionadas a Tecnologia.

● Vivência em Projetos com o Protheus - técnicos.

● Conhecimento em Protheus



Requisitos desejáveis

Um diferencial, conhecimento no Configurador de Tributos do módulo Fiscal do Protheus, para apoio aos clientes na Reforma Tributária. Certificações relacionadas a projetos, Protheus e atendimento ao cliente.


Benefícios

  • Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada pessoa colaboradora;
  • Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada TOTVER com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;
  • Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para nossas pessoas colaboradoras;
  • Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para pessoas colaboradoras e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...
  • Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;
  • Vale transporte e fretados em algumas estações do metrô;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;
  • Espaço de lactário;
  • Bicicletário;
  • Vestiário;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;
  • Gympass.



Sobre a empresa

Se você é uma pessoa que é gente boa, gosta de aprender e é apaixonada por resultados, você está no lugar certo! Como maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, queremos construir um ecossistema cada vez mais forte, com pessoas que gostem de inovar e acreditem na colaboração para fazer a diferença!


Aqui temos um ambiente dinâmico, que celebra a diversidade, promove a inclusão e está sempre em busca dos melhores resultados! Acreditamos no poder transformador da tecnologia e na sua capacidade de contribuir para a construção de uma sociedade mais diversa e inclusiva. Por isso, temos compromisso com nossa política e programa de diversidade e inclusão para garantirmos um ecossistema cada vez mais representativo, respeitoso e acolhedor.

title: Project Manager (Req. English)
description:
Fetchly Labs is a forward-thinking technology company specializing in innovative software solutions and digital products. We operate in a dynamic remote work environment that fosters collaboration and technological advancement across diverse project teams.
Job Responsibilities:
- Lead and manage software development projects from initiation to delivery, ensuring alignment with business goals and technical requirements
- Collaborate closely with product teams to define project scopes, timelines, and deliverables
- Utilize Agile methodologies to plan sprints, coordinate teams, and facilitate meetings
- Prepare comprehensive technical documentation and communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels
- Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks to ensure timely and quality delivery
- Lead cross-functional teams, fostering a productive and motivated work environment
- Monitor project progress and performance metrics, providing regular updates to stakeholders
Required Qualifications:
- 2 to 5+ years of experience in project management and product management roles, preferably in technology or software development
- Proven knowledge of Agile methodologies and project management tools
- Strong technical background with the ability to understand complex product requirements
- Excellent English communication skills, ranging from intermediate to fluent
- College degree in a relevant field; a Master’s degree or higher is preferred
Preferred Qualifications:
- Certification in Project Management (PMP, Scrum Master, or similar)
- Experience working in fully remote teams and across multiple time zones
- Advanced skills in stakeholder engagement and risk management
- Prior exposure to technical writing and documentation best practicesScreening questions

title: Coletor de Mídia
description:
Responsável pela coleta de dados de programação e veiculações em diferentes plataformas de mídia, como TV aberta, TV fechada, rádio, serviços de streaming, etc.


Atividades :


  • Coletar todos os dias a programação e os intervalos comerciais de todas as plataformas de mídia que fazem parte da cobertura da Kantar.
  • Avisar a área de suporte sempre que houver alguma falha na gravação de um programa ou intervalo, para que possam identificar e corrigir o problema.
  • Informar a equipe de Preços quando houver diferença entre o programa cadastrado no sistema e o que foi realmente exibido.
  • Garantir que o registro dos anunciantes exibidos esteja correto. Se não for possível identificar o anunciante, acionar a área de Pesquisa para confirmar com as agências.
  • Testar e validar melhorias no sistema que impactem o trabalho do dia a dia.
  • Revisar e corrigir eventuais erros identificados.
  • Participar dos projetos da área sempre que for solicitado.
  • Realizar outras atividades relacionadas, conforme orientação do superior.


Escala: 5x2 Rotativa, garantindo 2 folgas por semana e 1 fim de semana por mês;

Horário de trabalho: 14h às 23h

Modelo : 100% remoto


O que é necessário?

  • Ensino Médio completo;
  • Conhecimento Intermediário de Informática (Pcte Office, Edição de Vídeos, etc.)


Desejável :

  • Ensino superior completo ou cursando: em Marketing, Publicidade e Propaganda, Rádio e TV ou relacionados.

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:

  • Salário fixo
  • Ajuda de custo
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Day off de Aniversário;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Convênio com Farmácias;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Programa de Qualidade de Vida: Total Pass; ginastica laboral com profissional de educação física toda semana; palestras sobre temas relevantes; vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais.
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: a Kantar valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua.

title: Full Stack Engineer (Remote, $110K USD)
description:
Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer

100% Remote | Must have at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST)


About Ascen

Ascen (ascen.com) is a back-office platform built exclusively for staffing companies. We empower staffing firms to focus on their clients and candidates by providing a robust suite of back-office services—including contractor onboarding, timesheets, payroll, invoicing, funding, and employer of record—within a sleek, white-label, all-in-one platform.


We’re profitable, experiencing rapid growth (ranked number 78 on the Inc. 5000 as one of the fastest-growing companies in the US), and backed by a publicly traded company. Now, we’re seeking an experienced Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our remote team and help drive our next phase of innovation.


Role Overview

In this role, you will be a crucial contributor to our platform, designing and implementing features across the tech stack, optimizing performance, and ensuring the highest security standards. You’ll have a chance to build impactful solutions that streamline staffing operations for our clients.


Ideal Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Python.
  • 5+ years of experience building web applications (FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
  • 2+ years of experience with JavaScript frameworks (React or Vue).
  • Comfortable independently developing full-stack features, from backend to frontend.
  • Extensive knowledge of cybersecurity best practices.
  • Experience with payments or fintech is preferred.
  • Must be able to work with at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST) .


Interview Process

  • Introductory Call – 15-30 minutes
  • Meet with a member of our team for a brief conversation about your background and the role.
  • Technical Deep Dive – 45-60 minutes
  • Walk us through a feature or project you’ve built, focusing on code review, design decisions, improvements, and lessons learned. This is an opportunity to showcase your technical expertise and problem-solving approach.

We empower staffing firms to focus on their clients and candidates by providing a robust suite of back-office services—including contractor onboarding, timesheets, payroll, invoicing, funding, and employer of record—within a sleek, white-label, all-in-one platform.


We’re profitable, experiencing rapid growth (ranked number 78 on the Inc. 5000 as one of the fastest-growing companies in the US), and backed by a publicly traded company. Now, we’re seeking an experienced Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer to join our remote team and help drive our next phase of innovation.


Role Overview

In this role, you will be a crucial contributor to our platform, designing and implementing features across the tech stack, optimizing performance, and ensuring the highest security standards. You’ll have a chance to build impactful solutions that streamline staffing operations for our clients.


Ideal Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Python.
  • 5+ years of experience building web applications (FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
  • 2+ years of experience with JavaScript frameworks (React or Vue).
  • Comfortable independently developing full-stack features, from backend to frontend.
  • Extensive knowledge of cybersecurity best practices.
  • Experience with payments or fintech is preferred.
  • Must be able to work with at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (EST) .


Interview Process

  • Introductory Call – 15-30 minutes
  • Meet with a member of our team for a brief conversation about your background and the role.
  • Technical Deep Dive – 45-60 minutes
  • Walk us through a feature or project you’ve built, focusing on code review, design decisions, improvements, and lessons learned. This is an opportunity to showcase your technical expertise and problem-solving approach.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados Pleno
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Sobre a Engenharia de Dados:

Somos a área responsável pela coleta, tratamento, organização e disponibilização dos dados nas soluções e API da Neoway, bem como manter a sustentação desses dados. Nossos times estão organizados de acordo com o contexto de negócio de cada pacote de dados que sustentamos. Estes times são compostos por uma coordenação técnica, responsável por fazer a ponte entre os times de dados e o time de negócio, e pessoas Engenheiras de Dados, responsáveis pelo desenvolvimento e configuração de todas as etapas do fluxo da operação e produção de dados.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Dentre as principais funções do papel estão:

  • Desenvolvimento de web crawling para coleta de dados;
  • Monitoramento dos serviços de produção;
  • Evolução e manutenção de serviços de coleta, tratamento e agregação;


Requisitos e qualificações

Para desenvolver tudo isso contamos que você possua/ou esteja a fim de aprender os conhecimentos abaixo:

  • Desenvolvimento web crawling;
  • Linguagem de programação Python;
  • MongoDB, Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQL;
  • Parser de HTML, JSON, PDF, entre outros;


Seguimos práticas básicas de desenvolvimento:

  • Testes unitários, integração, e em alguns casos, sistema.
  • Projeto de infraestrutura como código.
  • Usamos CI do gitlab, para automatizar a maior parte de rotinas (testes, release).
  • Nos preocupamos com um código limpo e bem estruturado.
  • Fazemos Code Review. Nenhuma mudança vai para a operação sem o time aprovar. Seja via thumbs up do Gitlab ou durante uma discussão da daily.
  • Todo desenvolvimento de uma nova fonte é baseado em especificações que são escritas pela nossa pessoa Data Owner. Nela temos as definições de inputs e outputs, regras de negócio e resultados esperados. A especificação técnica fica sob responsabilidade do desenvolvedor que tem total abertura para decidir a melhor forma de desenvolvimento em conjunto com os demais colegas de time.

Vale Alimentação/Refeição;

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados Pleno
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


Sobre a Engenharia de Dados:

Somos a área responsável pela coleta, tratamento, organização e disponibilização dos dados nas soluções e API da Neoway, bem como manter a sustentação desses dados. Nossos times estão organizados de acordo com o contexto de negócio de cada pacote de dados que sustentamos. Estes times são compostos por uma coordenação técnica, responsável por fazer a ponte entre os times de dados e o time de negócio, e pessoas Engenheiras de Dados, responsáveis pelo desenvolvimento e configuração de todas as etapas do fluxo da operação e produção de dados.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

Dentre as principais funções do papel estão:

  • Desenvolvimento de web crawling para coleta de dados;
  • Monitoramento dos serviços de produção;
  • Evolução e manutenção de serviços de coleta, tratamento e agregação;


Requisitos e qualificações

Para desenvolver tudo isso contamos que você possua/ou esteja a fim de aprender os conhecimentos abaixo:

  • Desenvolvimento web crawling;
  • Linguagem de programação Python;
  • MongoDB, Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQL;
  • Parser de HTML, JSON, PDF, entre outros;


Seguimos práticas básicas de desenvolvimento:

  • Testes unitários, integração, e em alguns casos, sistema.
  • Projeto de infraestrutura como código.
  • Usamos CI do gitlab, para automatizar a maior parte de rotinas (testes, release).
  • Nos preocupamos com um código limpo e bem estruturado.
  • Fazemos Code Review. Nenhuma mudança vai para a operação sem o time aprovar. Seja via thumbs up do Gitlab ou durante uma discussão da daily.
  • Todo desenvolvimento de uma nova fonte é baseado em especificações que são escritas pela nossa pessoa Data Owner. Nela temos as definições de inputs e outputs, regras de negócio e resultados esperados. A especificação técnica fica sob responsabilidade do desenvolvedor que tem total abertura para decidir a melhor forma de desenvolvimento em conjunto com os demais colegas de time.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a DevOps Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to infrastructure automation, continuous delivery, observability, and security by collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. The DevOps engineer evaluates emerging technologies, promotes process improvements, and shapes standards and best practices while providing expert guidance to project teams across the organization. This role plays a fundamental role in driving the adoption of cloud platform capabilities in collaboration with software engineering, architecture, and information security teams


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Deploy & Configure AWS Cloud Services;
  • Deploy & Configure Kubernetes resources;
  • Help elaborating or contributing to RFC and ADRs documents describing technical solutions;
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) – Automate infrastructure deployment;
  • CI/CD Pipeline Automation – Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions;
  • Observability & Monitoring – Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions;
  • Disaster Recovery & Security – Develop automated backup strategies, define disaster recovery plans, and implement security best practices;
  • Workflow Automation & Integration – Build integrations to automate deployment processes, security checks, and operational workflows.



Essential Skills

  • Experience in a DevOps role, with hands-on AWS experience;
  • Experience with IaC tools, ideally Terraform and Helm Charts;
  • Experience with containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools like CircleCI and GithubActions;
  • Experience with AWS services (EC2, S3, ECS, EKS, RDS, Lambda, VPC);
  • Knowledge of security best practices for cloud environments;
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills;
  • Familiarity with Ruby or Golang;
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (Bash, Shell, or Python).



Highly Desirable Skills

  • Networking & Security – Familiarity with DNS, Zero Trust, load balancing, IAM, firewall rules, VPNs, and cloud security best practices;
  • Monitoring & Observability – Experience using Datadog, CloudWatch;
  • Experience with Kubernetes packet managers (e.g. Helm, Kubectl);
  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain KDB+/q databases and real-time data processing systems supporting trading and research.

  • Troubleshoot production issues, ensuring high data quality, reliability, and uptime.
  • Partner with quantitative researchers and traders to design new data-driven features and analytics.



Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 3-8 years of hands-on experience developing in KDB+/q within a trading or financial environment.
  • Strong understanding of time-series data, market data structures, and real-time data processing.
  • Solid working knowledge of Linux and scripting for system monitoring and automation.
  • Proficiency in query optimization, data modeling, and performance tuning in KDB.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with engineering, quant, and trading teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and reliability.

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Cross-border Customs Operations
description:
Location: São Paulo, Brazil


Responsibilities:

1. Manage and oversee the logistics and customs clearance processes of platform products from China to Brazil, ensuring compliance with Brazilian laws and regulations.

2. Coordinate relationships with Brazilian customs, logistics providers, and government agencies to enhance clearance quality and efficiency.

3. Track changes in customs policies and regulations in the Brazilian market to ensure compliance and forward-thinking business operations.

4. Address issues in cross-border e-commerce clearance operations such as inspections, timeliness, customer complaints, and key processes.

5. Develop and execute strategies to optimize tariffs and logistics costs, improving AliExpress's competitiveness in the Brazilian market.

6. Provide training in cross-border customs matters to enhance the professional capabilities of team members.


Localização: São Paulo, Brasil


Responsabilidades:

1. Gerir e supervisionar os processos logísticos e de desalfandegamento de produtos da plataforma da China para o Brasil, garantindo conformidade com as leis e regulamentos brasileiros.

2. Coordenar relações com a alfândega brasileira, fornecedores logísticos e agências governamentais para melhorar a qualidade e eficiência do desalfandegamento.

3. Acompanhar as mudanças nas políticas e regulamentos aduaneiros no mercado brasileiro para assegurar a conformidade e operações comerciais com visão de futuro.

4. Resolver problemas na operação de desalfandegamento do comércio eletrônico transfronteiriço como inspeções, prazos, reclamações de clientes e processos chave.

5. Desenvolver e executar estratégias para otimizar tarifas e custos logísticos, aumentando a competitividade do AliExpress no mercado brasileiro.

6. Oferecer treinamento em assuntos aduaneiros transfronteiriços para melhorar as capacidades profissionais dos membros da equipe.



Requirements:


1. Education: Bachelor's degree or above in international trade, logistics management, e-commerce, or related fields.


2. Experience:

◦ At least 3 years of experience in cross-border e-commerce and customs management.

◦ Experience operating e-commerce platforms in Brazil preferred.


3. Skills:

◦ Familiar with and proficient in customs processes between Brazil and China, and platform operation standards.

◦ Excellent communication and negotiation skills, capable of negotiating in various complex situations.

◦ Strong analytical skills for problem location and project management; ability to proactively optimize and implement solutions.

◦ Proficient in using relevant customs management software and e-commerce platform tools.


4. Language:

◦ Fluent in Portuguese with excellent written and spoken capabilities.

◦ Fluent in English; Mandarin skills preferred.


5. Other Requirements:

◦ Strong sense of responsibility and attention to business details.

◦ Adapt to rapidly changing international e-commerce environment and actively promote ongoing business development.


Requisitos:


1. Educação: Bacharelado ou superior em comércio internacional, gestão logística, comércio eletrônico ou áreas afins.


2. Experiência:

◦ Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência em comércio eletrônico transfronteiriço e gestão aduaneira.

◦ Experiência operando plataformas de comércio eletrônico no Brasil preferida.


3. Habilidades:

◦ Familiaridade e proficiência nos processos aduaneiros entre Brasil e China, e normas de operação de plataforma.

◦ Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e negociação, capaz de negociar em várias situações complexas.

◦ Fortes habilidades analíticas para localização de problemas e gerenciamento de projetos; capacidade de otimizar e implementar soluções proativamente.

◦ Proficiente em usar software de gestão aduaneira relevante e ferramentas de plataforma de comércio eletrônico.

description:

A Stefanini LATAM está buscando um profissional hands-on com sólida experiência em SAP HANA (on-premise e/ou cloud) para atuar em um projeto internacional com foco em modelagem de dados, performance tuning e integração com SAP Datasphere e SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) .

100% remoto

Fuso horário EST

Contrato via Deel (PJ/Contractor)

Início urgente (imediato)

Inglês fluente obrigatório

  • Desenvolver e otimizar modelos SAP HANA (calculation views, graphical/scripted, SQL).
  • Trabalhar com HANA Cloud e integrações com SAP ECC / S/4HANA.
  • Construir e dar manutenção em modelos no SAP Datasphere , integrando-os ao HANA.
  • Conectar e disponibilizar dados para o SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) via live connections.
  • Realizar análises de performance e tuning em HANA e SAC .

✔ +5 anos com desenvolvimento /consultoria técnica SAP HANA (on-premise ou cloud)

✔ Domínio em:

  • Calculation views
  • SQLScript
  • Joins, unions, projections
  • Performance tuning

✔ Experiência com Datasphere / DWC (camadas, entidades, views, mapping)

✔ Trabalhar com dados oriundos de ECC ou S/4HANA

✔ Vivência com SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC)

✔ Inglês fluente

title: ANALISTA PREVENÇÃO RISCOS E FRAUDES PL
description:
Resumo da Vaga:

O Analista de Prevenção a Riscos e Fraudes Pleno será responsável por investigar denúncias e suspeitas de fraudes no Grupo Petrópolis, recebidas pelo Canal de Conduta e outros meios oficiais. O profissional atuará de maneira imparcial, ética e legal, visando identificar e esclarecer fatos, fraudes de colaboradores e terceiros. O foco é fornecer informações cruciais para a tomada de decisões dentro dos parâmetros legais, normas e procedimentos internos, além de apoiar o jurídico nas análises dos casos.



OBJETIVOS:

Avaliação de Denúncias e Demandas:

  • Analisar e avaliar denúncias de fraudes oriundas do Canal de Conduta e outros meios oficiais, identificando os procedimentos a serem adotados e contribuindo com informações para decisões internas.

Investigações Sistêmicas:

  • Realizar investigações utilizando sistemas internos, envolvendo públicos internos e externos, para detectar violações legais, políticas e procedimentos. Identificar oportunidades de ações corretivas nos processos da empresa contribuindo para melhoria contínua.

Investigações em Campo:

  • Conduzir investigações, com diligências e contato com testemunhas e envolvidos, coletando evidências (vídeos, fotos, depoimentos, relatórios) para subsidiar a investigação.

Elaboração de Relatórios:

  • Preparar relatórios detalhados com os resultados das investigações, identificando falhas ou não conformidades e informando as áreas pertinentes, como o departamento jurídico.
  • Atualização Constante:

Manter-se atualizado quanto às normas e procedimentos internos relativos às investigações e prevenção a fraudes.

  • Apoio à Gestão:

Auxiliar na criação de materiais e apresentações para reporte à gestão, além de apoiar na elaboração e revisão de diretrizes e procedimentos do departamento.



DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência em Segurança Pública: Profissionais com histórico em segurança pública, como policiais, bombeiros ou agentes de segurança;
  • Cursos relacionados a investigação e prevenção de fraudes, técnicas de entrevista, conhecimento em Compliance e Canal de conduta;
  • Experiência nas Forças Armadas: Profissionais com experiência militar, incluindo ex-militares e reservistas.



REQUISITOS:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração de Empresas, Gestão em Segurança Empresarial, Investigações de fraudes, Compliance e áreas correlacionadas;
  • Conhecimentos básicos das atividades de Compliance;
  • Gestão de Riscos e Investigações;
  • Análise de Dados;
  • Conhecimento no sistema SAP;
  • Excel Intermediário/ Avançado e BI;
  • Experiência na área de prevenção à fraude;
  • Conhecimento de coleta de dados e informações de fontes públicas (OSINT);
  • Habilitação categoria B ativa;

title: Merchant Experience Improvement Manager
description:
About Us：

Keeta , the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better, " we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong . With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia , Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

Know more:Keeta website


What You'll Do:

  • Understand the basic operations of the food delivery industry. Identify the issues merchants encounter on various delivery platforms and gain insights into their genuine needs.
  • Based on merchant needs , drive the initiation, implementation, and achievement of results for various projects within the company. The projects include product projects and process improvements projects.
  • Establish a merchant experience indicator system , and guide the project advancement through the monitoring and operation of experience indicators.


What We Need From You:

  • Have certain operational experience in user experience.
  • Possess certain experience in building and operating indicator systems , familiar with various research tools, and methods for analyzing research results.
  • Possess certain project management capabilities , able to collaborate with multiple parties to ensure project outcomes are achieved. Have a certain product-oriented mindset.
  • Priority will be given to those familiar with the food delivery industry. Candidates with experience in internet companies are preferred.
  • Can use English and Portuguese as working languages.
  • Priority will be given to candidates familiar with product modules related to merchant settlement and billing in the Brazilian market.
  • Priority will be given to those familiar with the merchant IM module .

title: LHP_Senior KDB/Q Developer_Remote Mexico dup
description:
Project Description:

Building a trading platform for innovative international top-tier hedge fund from the ground up, comprising of front-office system for traders, pre-trade checks and analysis, intra-day positions management, order management and routing, risks and limits management, reports of trading activities, FIX connectivity, market data providers connectivity (e.g. Bloomberg B-pipe).


Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain KDB+/q databases and real-time data processing systems supporting trading and research.
  • Build and optimize data ingestion pipelines from multiple market data sources using Kafka.
  • Collaborate with Java developers to integrate KDB systems with trading, analytics, and risk applications.
  • Support React-based front-end interfaces by developing efficient APIs and query services for visualization and analysis.
  • Monitor and tune performance of large-scale time-series datasets for latency and throughput.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, ensuring high data quality, reliability, and uptime.
  • Partner with quantitative researchers and traders to design new data-driven features and analytics.



Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 3-8 years of hands-on experience developing in KDB+/q within a trading or financial environment.
  • Strong understanding of time-series data, market data structures, and real-time data processing.
  • Solid working knowledge of Linux and scripting for system monitoring and automation.
  • Proficiency in query optimization, data modeling, and performance tuning in KDB.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with engineering, quant, and trading teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and reliability.


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (C#/.NET/React.js)
description:
We're looking for full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Software Engineers with 7+ years of experience delivering production-ready software. The ideal candidates will have recent hands-on C# /.NET, modern JS framework (Vue.js, React.js (preferred), Angular), and extensive end-to-end API and integration experience. You should thrive in fast-moving environments and be able to quickly translate ambiguous goals into working features, rapidly master new tools, and own your code from design through post-release support.

You'll collaborate with Senior and Staff engineers across North and South America, owning features from concept through production support and seeing users benefit almost immediately. If delivering practical solutions quickly and refining them in live environments motivates you, you'll fit right in.

Founded in 2003, our client transforms the traditional restaurant point-of-sale (POS) terminal into an integrated 360-degree operational management system. Their solution enhances brand loyalty through improved customer experiences, optimizes operations to result in lower costs, and boosts sales volumes through comprehensive analytics and employee performance insights. Over 7,000 restaurant locations utilize their technology today, processing more than $5 billion in payments annually.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform full life-cycle commercial software development and maintenance, including analyzing specifications, documenting requirements, and architecting, designing, developing, and maintaining software solutions
  • Collaborate with teams to design, develop, and produce high-quality code following best practices and standards for both new features and existing application maintenance
  • Own features end-to-end - UI through API and Data layer too
  • Support and refactor legacy code using modern methodologies and technologies
  • Analyze code to identify defect root causes and provide resolutions
  • Participate in daily standups and weekly team meetings to review priorities, progress, new ideas, and technologies
  • Address defects identified during various testing cycles
  • Perform high-quality peer reviews


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and spoken English; must be able to discuss trade-offs with teammates and stakeholders
  • 7+ years professional C#/.NET (Core and Framework) experience - recent in the last 2 years
  • Modern JavaScript framework experience, preferably React.js (Vue.js, OR Angular) - delivering new features, not just fixing bugs
  • Comfortable working end-to-end (UI, API, data layer, infra scripts); whatever it takes
  • Must have "ownership mindset" - you'll have the responsibility of designing, building, shipping, monitoring, and fixing the features you touch
  • Fluent in Git and modern branching / PR workflows
  • Rapid learner as you're expected to ramp up on a new library or API in hours, not weeks
  • Team first approach displaying transparency, reliability, decisiveness, and a laser focus on customer impact
  • Rapid learner as you're expected to ramp up on a new library or API in hours, not weeks


Desired Experience (Not Required)

  • Daily use of Docker/containers (you wrote the Dockerfile)
  • Azure PaaS (Container Apps, SQL, Cosmos DB, etc.)
  • Track record of expanding scope of responsibility over time (e.g., owning more complex features, introducing new tooling)
  • Obsession with metrics, logging, and user impact


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with innovative and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human, let's learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Senior Project Manager


**Add resumes in English**


In this role, you will collaborate with key infrastructure stakeholders and business partners in defining project scope, interpreting requirements and priorities, and leading the modernization and transformation of systems. The projects you lead will primarily include infrastructure and application integrations and other infrastructure initiatives. Ideally you are highly skilled in communicating with technical teams, business stakeholders, and C-Suite Executives and you have a well-rounded understanding of the various components of an enterprise IT environment.


Responsabilities:

• Drive project management decisions, governance, and long-term vision.

• Analyze divisional business requirements and translate these into technical deliverables organized as Executive Milestones (In/Out of Scope).

• Develop expert 'As Is' knowledge of platform systems and help define 'To Be' system solutions and flows (e.g., must understand before planning).

• Understand infrastructure requirements and deployment of solutions for OnPrem and Cloud Computing service models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS).

• Analyze data to identify key insights and apply them to the business; quantitative and qualitative analysis.

• Ensure coordination of teams to drive timely completion of deliverables of large projects.

• Manage project budgets and financials, including resource allocations supporting a project’s schedule.

• Define and provide KPI’s and metrics for assigned projects.

• Interact closely with stakeholders and vendors and provide communications to executive management.

• Operationally troubleshoot or lead the troubleshooting of complex issues.

• Proactively ensure compliance (processes, standards, methodology) with expected quality.

• Responsible for project-related organizational change management including communications, training, and adoption.

• General understanding of infrastructure requirements to deploy solutions for storage, middleware, DB, voice specifics (call/contact centers), and network (routers, switches, firewalls, load balancing, WAF).

• Definition, implementation, and adoption of processes.


Requirements:

• Advanced English (mandatory)

• Bachelor’s degree and solid experience in Project/Program Management.

• Experience managing merger and acquisition infrastructure and application integration or divestiture projects preferred.

• Project Management Professional and/or Certified Scrum Master preferred.

• Experience managing requirements for multiple large, complex, and cross functional projects. Emphasis on systems, technologies, business process redesign, and knowledge of technical environments.

• Experience producing detailed project plans and resource requirements.

• Exceptional verbal and written communication skills – must be comfortable speaking and writing interacting with C-level audiences, as well as technical and non-technical audiences.

• Excellent communication, interpersonal, organizational, and negotiation skills.

• Proven ability to write business requirements, including user stories, use case development and work-flow documentation.

• Product and project management skills; business judgment, including ability to balance resources, evaluate and address risks, and concisely articulate where trade-off decisions are to be made.

• Strong orientation to user-base, including ability to understand needs and apply this knowledge to product enhancements, online user experience, and communication content (internal and external).

title: Sales representative
description:
ABOUT US


Property Leads is a premium Pay-Per-Lead company that generates high-quality, inbound, motivated seller leads for real estate investors. We are a team of ambitious, results-driven individuals with bold goals for both our company and our personal growth. While many companies describe themselves as a family, we see ourselves as a high-performance sports team, focused, competitive, and committed to winning.

We're looking for someone who is motivated, friendly, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is ready to take on challenges head-on.

THE ROLE


We’re hiring a dynamic and driven Sales & Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team. This role is responsible for selling motivated seller leads to both inbound and outbound prospects, managing their pipeline, and serving as a key point of contact in our customer journey.

This is more than just a sales role, as you’ll be the first impression of Property Leads. Professionalism, strong communication skills, great English, and the ability to build rapport quickly are essential. You should be passionate about helping people succeed and eager to grow within a fast-moving organization.

This role is best suited for individuals with at least one year of experience in commission-based sales.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct onboarding calls, schedule new appointments, and nurture leads in the pipeline

  • Manage and optimize our CRM to enhance lead tracking, segmentation, and conversion

  • Analyze lead data and provide actionable insights to improve sales and outreach

  • Ensure timely follow-up and accurate documentation of all client interactions

  • Work closely with the Sales Manager to drive performance and refine processes

    • QUALIFICATIONS

    • 1+ years of commission sales experience

    • Strong

    • 1+ years of CRM management experience, ideally in real estate or lead generation

    • Proficiency in CRM platforms (e.g., GoHighLevel) and Airtable

    • Strong problem-solving skills

    • This role requires strong proficiency in both written and verbal English. You should be comfortable drafting emails, participating in meetings, and handling client interactions.

    • Self-motivated and collaborative with a strong sense of accountability

    • Self-aware and heavy emphasis on constant self-improvement.

    • WHAT WE OFFER

    • Competitive base pay with performance-based bonuses

    • Remote-friendly work environment

    • Clear paths for career advancement and professional development

    • Supportive, high-performing team culture
